definitions.C: no recorder contact involving the target from event start through hold end
definitions.L: lead stays >= 4.0 m for 100 steps after completion
definitions.P: along-track lead crosses 4.0 m after an approach inside [-20.0, -4.0] m
definitions.S_v3: hold window speed >= 1.0 m/s, true heading cos >= 0.82, no backward flag, per-step |delta lat_true| <= 0.1
definitions.T_v3: in-corridor fraction >= 0.7 over the maneuver window [complete - 25, complete + 100] with |lat_true| <= 1.0

denominator_policy: all planned case-algorithm rows retained; censored and missing rows count as failures

endpoints.E_full: P and L and C and T_v3 and S_v3
endpoints.E_valid: P and L and C and T_v3

heading_cos_true: |dot((cos hull_angle, sin hull_angle), local centre-line tangent)|
lat_true: |(position - nearest centreline sample) . (cos beta, sin beta)| / TRACK_WIDTH, beta = track[:,1] (the simulator's border-normal angle); |lat_true| <= 1 is inside the road edge because TRACK_WIDTH is the road half-width

legacy_defects.heading_cos: recorded value is cos(border_normal - hull_angle), i.e. the sine of the true heading error
legacy_defects.lateral_error: recorded value is the local-tangent projection, structurally bounded by half the centre-line sample spacing
legacy_defects.window: legacy corridor and stability clauses were evaluated over the whole event window, including an approach phase that can last hundreds of steps

off_road_run_policy: longest continuous off-road run is reported (distribution plus run-limit sweep at [10, 25, 50, 100]) and is not a gate: it is failed by the hand-tuned rule controllers as well, so it discriminates nothing between methods
threshold_calibration: in_corridor_min and lateral_step_bound are fixed before evaluation from the rule-controller distribution
